videos.video_subject: In 1995 CD Nacional signed the ten-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo from CF Andorinha, and the fee was famously paid in football equipment - reportedly two sets of kit and a bag of footballs
videos.video_script: In nineteen ninety five, a club called Nacional signed him from Andorinha. The fee was two sets of kit and a bag of footballs. That was the price of Cristiano Ronaldo. The entire price.
